description:
Activate Rainveil Rejuvenator by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Repeat.
